_comment: Hand-written world metadata sidecar for level.mini.json.
Named LevelMeta.json rather than something.mini.json because that is how the
app finds it: a .sav is compressed, so `sniff` matches this slot on the
filename and the reader checks the contents. Renaming this file stops it being
recognised, which is the intended behaviour, not a fragility.
The whole real file is four values in 2,122 decompressed bytes, so unlike
level.mini.json there is nothing here to redact — this is the shape.
Timestamp is the level's own Timestamp to the tick, which is what a real pair
has — both are written by the same save operation. It is comfortably after the
newest OwnedTime in the world (639211541161540000), so the Files row reads
`loaded` rather than `flagged`. Lower it below that figure and
levelMetaPredatesWorld flags it as an earlier snapshot instead, which is the
other half of what this fixture is for.
